To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

we have developed a novel learning framework for learning the local feature descriptors, which can be applied to both weakly and strongly supervised cases and which improves the state of the-art performance in both cases.

1) learning pooling regions for a descriptor can be formulated using a sparsity regularisation and 2) learning descriptor dimensionality reduction using a Mahalanobis regularisation can improve the performance of a descriptor, 3) learning descriptors from unannota ted data can be done in a weakly supervised manner, 4) the descriptors learnt in this work can be used in a compressed form, which is suitable for the applications with limited computational resources.

the proposed learning methods for local feature descriptors outperform state-of-the-art methods in descriptor learning, and that the descriptors obtained from the learnt descriptors by binarization outperform state-of-art methods in descriptor matching.
